sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. Please note that our raw material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning short-term market decreases do not immediately reduce our cost base. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

We acknowledge the recent development of the AS-14404 index and are willing to incorporate the requested index clause into the agreement. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.74 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €5.68 per unit, a contract term of 12 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

decisions.tactician: E0 and o9 give the lowest C, but a firm price over a long horizon with no clause ignores this supplier's strongest need, so it would likely push back hard. o8 meets that need with the AS-14404 clause, and the moderate deadband keeps the clause cost to us low. It also keeps C close to the other twelve-month options and leaves room to trade toward a longer term later. This is an anchoring counter to its first offer, so it should prompt a counter rather than a walk-away.

decisions.tactician: o8 keeps the clause it explicitly wants, which is its strongest need, and adds a two-year commitment that it likely values but the option model does not count. Our C is about €999k, versus €1.109m on its standing sheet. The no-clause options look slightly cheaper on paper, but dropping a clause it has just conceded would invite resistance. Leaving the clause out also gives up the protection, which is worth about 1.3 % to it and is our best trade item. E0 has the same price and C, but its 36 months adds nothing within our two-year horizon and may look like overreach. Its concession pace suggests one more step can close the gap, and the delivery-record argument is a new kind it has not yet heard.
